intents.entry_convention: Volume-confirmed daily close below $14.20; do not short into an intact uptrend
intents.invalidation: Hard stop above $14.97 (10 EMA reclaim); decisive close above $16.20 on expanding volume voids the bear posture entirely
intents.horizon: 1-2 quarters (until the liquidity event — buyback halt or capital raise — resolves)
intents.reevaluation: Revisit thesis if Q3 shows genuine gross margin recovery, operating cash flow repeats Q2's level, and buyback paused without a capital raise; close above $16.20 on expanding volume — stay flat and revisit on next pullback
intents.ambiguity: Headline is Sell with zero current exposure; the only usable forward instruction is a conditional SHORT entry — probe size stated as a range (3-5% of portfolio notional, ~$3,000-5,000), no specific limit price given for entry itself
